title: [LOGISTICS] First road never tasked: add fallback anchor + player cut-road command
description: supply_chain_manager.gd:216-218 silently returns when no second firebase/depot anchor in range -> first depot on map never generates BUILD_ROAD job. Bulldozer cut_path disabled under WorkerController; no player road verb exists. BUILD_ROAD prereqs (CLEAR+FLATTEN) stall must surface, not hang PENDING forever.

title: [LOGISTICS] Spawn gating on terrain_ready; no unit may trust get_height_at=0.0 sentinel
description: Extends o2k. UnifiedTerrainEngine.get_height_at returns hard 0.0 when heightmap null (unified_terrain_engine.gd:252, terrain_integration.gd:267); heightmap loads async AFTER spawns. reinforcement_manager.gd:243-256 never samples height (offset.y=0, physics disabled while hidden so snap never corrects). Fix: terrain_ready signal + deferred spawn helper; _snap_to_terrain skips while uninitialized; reinforcement spawns sample height.

title: [LOGISTICS] Worker job discovery: use XZ-plane distance, not 3D
description: job_system.gd:619 get_best_job_for_worker + _score_job use full 3D distance_to(job centroid) bounded by 150m search_radius. A worker stranded at Y=0 under high terrain sees ALL jobs out of range -> permanent idle with only throttled debug print (worker_controller.gd:559). Spawn bug directly causes idle bug. Fix: score on XZ; re-snap worker before first search; log when zero jobs in radius.

title: [CRASH] TerrainClearingSystem.apply_clearing_damage does not exist; bulldozer.gd calls it unguarded
description: bulldozer.gd:357,392 call apply_clearing_damage unguarded; autoload lacks the method. Blocked in main scene only because test_combined spawns bulldozers as Squads (test_combined.gd:609) and WorkerController blocks direct commands (bulldozer.gd:586,618). Any Bulldozer-class scene with allow_direct_commands=true errors per physics frame. Fix: implement forwarder on TerrainClearingSystem delegating to ClearingSystem, or guard + route via JobSystem; consider deleting dead PATH_CUTTING branch.

title: [FREEZE] Coalesce terrain chunk rebuilds; defer trimesh collision cook
description: terrain_manager.gd:110-146 _process_rebuild_queue checks 8ms budget BEFORE popping so always completes >=1 full chunk (20-30ms incl. terrain_chunk.gd:290 create_trimesh_shape synchronous cook + vegetation regen). terrain_flattening.gd:62-74 triggers per 1% progress. Fix: mutate mesh heights in place, debounce rebuilds to job completion, move collision cook to WorkerThreadPool or use HeightMapShape3D.

title: [FREEZE] Debounce clearing->vegetation regen via existing 0.2s batch
description: clearing_system.gd:126 rewrites terrain area every physics tick during squad clearing (squad.gd:1134); terrain_integration.gd:605 handles cell_updated synchronously with NO debounce -> vegetation MultiMesh destroyed+rebuilt 60x/sec per clearing unit. The handler 5 lines below (_on_unified_terrain_modified) already batches at 0.2s. Route through it; write terrain state on stage transitions only. ~15 lines. Primary freeze fix.
